primarySymptom.title: Primary Symptom
primarySymptom.description: Primary symptom cluster, e.g. vasomotor, sleep, mood, cognition, gsm, bleeding.

redFlagsAcknowledged.title: Red Flags Acknowledged
redFlagsAcknowledged.description: The MANDATORY red-flag screen result — yes / no / none. Required: the handoff refuses to route without it. Ask the patient the single yes/no safety question and pass their answer (yes or no).

patientInsurance.title: Patient Insurance
patientInsurance.description: Payer name. When present, Benefits verification is chained automatically (no need to also set verifyCoverage).

verifyCoverage.title: Verify Coverage
verifyCoverage.description: Set true to force a Benefits/eligibility check even without an inline payer.

book.title: Book
book.description: Set true to book an appointment after routing. Only books when the pathway is an MSCP visit AND a providerId is supplied.

providerId.title: Provider Id
providerId.description: NPI / provider id to book with (required for booking).

modality.title: Modality
modality.description: telehealth | in-person. Defaults to the pathway's modality.

requestedDate.title: Requested Date
requestedDate.description: Preferred date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd) for the booking.

screenSdoh.title: Screen Sdoh
screenSdoh.description: A complete coded AHC-HRSN screen as one string, domain:vector pairs separated by ';' — e.g. "housing:1,1;food:0,0;transportation:0;utilities:0;safety:1,1,1,1". Item counts: housing 2 (0-7), food 2 (0-2), transportation 1 (0-1), utilities 1 (0-2), safety 4 (1-5). An incomplete screen is skipped (it never breaks routing).

sdohScreener.title: Sdoh Screener
sdohScreener.description: Validated screener id; defaults to ahc-hrsn.

sdohConsent.title: Sdoh Consent
sdohConsent.description: Set true if the patient consented to community-resource referrals.
